name: Foreign Exchange Trade Confirmation Request Amendment Request V 02
definition: Scope|The ForeignExchangeTradeConfirmationRequestAmendmentRequest message is sent from a market participant to a Central matching utility (CMU) to amend the ForeignExchangeTradeConfirmationRequest previously sent.||Usage|The request is sent by the market participants to the CMU after the confirmation is requested.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Specifies the trading side of the treasury trade which is captured.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Specifies the counterparty side of the treasury trade which is captured.

TradeDetail.name: Trade Detail
TradeDetail.definition: Details of the treasury trade confirmed.

QueryStartNumber.name: Query Start Number
QueryStartNumber.definition: Number which the query results will start from.

QueryTradeStatus.name: Query Trade Status
QueryTradeStatus.definition: Specifies the inquiry status of the trade.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
